output.description: capture_app_window returns path and capture_id. detection_app_window_objects returns capture_id, image_size and predictions with original image-pixel coords; it does not automatically add screen coordinates. convert_app_window_coordinates returns capture_id, window_bounds_points [x,y,width,height], screen_coordinate_space macos_global_top_left_points_at_capture and boxes with image_bounds_pixels, screen_bounds_points and screen_center_points. Points are capture-time macOS global top-left logical points, potentially negative, not authorization to click. References expire after 300 seconds; pre-existing screenshots have no capture record. Successful click_app_element returns {"clicked":true}; a separately reported verification status of not_performed is not a claim of independent protocol-level verification. Failure after dispatch or inability to establish a state transition is unknown, not a safe retry. Read-only inspect_app_element returns {"diagnostic_code":"matched"} on a current match; this neither dispatches input nor authorizes a later click. Successful input_app_element returns {"text_input":true} after exact AXValue readback; that readback is not independent verification.
